# Material changes: a pull request touching any of these needs the owner's review before it merges (the
# `owner-approved-paths` label, applied by the owner by hand after the last push). Everything else is routine
# and merges once `test` and `guardrails/policy` pass and an independent review signs it off (see
# docs/agents/TASKS.md, "Merging"). One extended regex per line, matched against the repo-relative path. Read
# from the BASE branch, so a pull request can't loosen its own rules.
#
# This list is narrower than protected-paths.txt, which is what cloud agents may not edit at all.

# the approval system itself: CI, this guard, agent settings and rules, the promotion script
^\.github/
^\.claude/
^CLAUDE\.md$
^AGENTS\.md$
^docs/agents/TASKS\.md$
^scripts/agents/

# deployment, infrastructure, secrets and the supply chain
^fly\.toml$
^Dockerfile$
^\.dockerignore$
^scripts/deploy
^next\.config\.ts$
^instrumentation\.ts$
^package\.json$
^package-lock\.json$
^lib/secret\.ts$

# authentication and authorization: sessions, tokens, rate limits, request plumbing, every API route and
# server action, and the pages that check reset, invite and email-confirmation tokens
^lib/(auth|http|emailverify|ratelimit|ssrf)\.ts$
^app/api/
^app/actions\.ts$
^(middleware|proxy)\.ts$
^app/(reset|invite|confirm-email)/

# production data: the schema, stored files and data paths
^lib/(db|storage|paths)\.ts$

# signature integrity and audit evidence: signing, sealing, certificates, the audit trail, consent, webhooks,
# the signing page, and the components that capture or adopt a signature or verify a document
^lib/(files|signer|audit|consent|webhooks|worker|email|convert)\.ts$
^lib/pdf/
^app/s/
^components/(SigningRoom|SignaturePad|VerifyForm|SettingsForms)\.tsx$

# the checks themselves: test runners, shared test helpers, and the evidence the detector is scored on
^playwright\.config\.ts$
^vitest\.config\.(ts|mts)$
^e2e/helpers\.ts$
^e2e/support/
^fixtures/(holdout|final|agreements)/
